name: Medication Management System
description: Builds medication tracking systems including schedule templates, refill reminder frameworks, interaction question lists for providers, and storage guidelines. Produces a medication management document that helps users stay organized and have informed conversations with their healthcare providers about their medications. Use when the user asks about organizing medications, building a medication schedule, tracking refills, or preparing medication questions for their provider. Do NOT use for medication recommendations, dosage adjustments, drug interaction assessments, or any guidance that replaces a pharmacist or prescribing provider.
